content.title: Open an existing published book detail page and inspect its bibliographic details, cover image, and package link
content.intent: Prove that a valid published-book detail page renders the promised credibility details, cover image, published-via package statement, and package link on the successful detail-page outcome.
content.technique_notes: Derived from REQ-08's successful detail-page outcome. Techniques: equivalence partitioning over resource state {existing published book}; happy-path inspection of a rendered web page. Kept as one scenario because the bibliographic fields, cover image, published-via statement, and package link are all promised on the same successful page outcome. No covering array applied: the source specifies no independent input dimensions to combine; the risk-judged interaction strength would have been 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies.
